verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs explicitly describe an observability system giving visibility into every agent run, workflow step, tool call, and model interaction, plus a local Studio UI (localhost:4111) for building/testing/managing agents and workflows, and live evals scoring outputs in real time. This directly matches the story of tracing LLM calls and tool invocations in an observability UI. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of the tracing UI in practice, and no detail on trace granularity or export/integration with third-party observability backends.
